ashwin: Heads-up — saw a perf regression on prod after the new INT8 kernel picker rolled. KV cache page churn up ~3x, reuse-hit down ~18%. Can reproduce on canary.
claire: When did the picker roll? any deploy id?
ashwin: rolled around 2195500000 (~2h ago). canary shows same signal. pprof snapshot: https://perf.internal/pprof/21955 (private)
ashwin: Config snippet from canary:
```json
{"kernel_picker":"dynamic_v2","quant_mode":"int8_packed","kv_coalesce":false}
```
tom: Did we change slot layout or slot size?
ashwin: We switched packing to 16-byte slots to try to improve memcpy alignment. With long contexts it increases fragmentation and creates many small pages that get evicted.
natalie: perf-bot, any alerts triggered?
perf-bot: ALERT: kv_evictions/sec crossed threshold (was 1200 -> current 3200). Top symptom: page churn + increased kernel fallback rate. :warning:
claire: Can you share a minimal repro we can run locally?
ashwin: Yep. Local repro command:
```bash
./tests/run_kv_stress --model mpt-30b --quant int8_packed --longctx 256k --profile
```
ashwin: With that, we see the fallback path where the runtime copies slot pages back to host and re-quantizes when the selected kernel isn't compatible. That copy+requant costs ~8ms/token on T4s in our sample.
tom: Oof. So dynamic_v2 sometimes picks a kernel that doesn't support int8_packed and triggers fallback?
ashwin: Exactly. Kernel selection chooses the lowest-latency kernel for current seq distribution but doesn't check slot packing compatibility in some edge cases. Fallback path = copy + requant + repost -> churn.
natalie: For quick mitigation: revert the dynamic picker or add a compatibility check to avoid picking non-compatible kernels for customers with longctx/int8. Also set kv_coalesce=true to reduce fragmentation.
claire: Agreed. Which is faster to ship? revert picker or coalesce-on-write?
tom: Revert picker is fastest (single flag). Coalesce requires a small runtime change but will help long-term.
natalie: Also add a canary gate to the int8_packed rollout until we add kernel compatibility guard.
ashwin: I'll open revert PR now and include the profile snapshot and the repro script. PR will be titled: "revert: dynamic_v2 kernel picker until int8 compatibility guard".
ashwin: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/4234 (will update)
natalie: After revert, let's run the longctx regression job and compare:
- baseline: evictions/sec ~1100
- current (broken): 3200
- target (post-fix): <=1300

perf-bot: Snapshot: post-revert baseline comparison queued (job 98431).
claire: Good. Assigning action items: ashwin -> revert PR + link, tom -> quick coalesce POC, natalie -> add kernel compatibility test to picker.
ashwin: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
